topic: A quotation built, sent, and accepted in the same afternoon — what that pipeline looks like in SmartPRO Hub
format: Build a tight case study: type of company, the problem they had, what changed, the one number that proves it worked
post:
A trading company in Muscat sent 14 quotations last month.

3 were accepted. The rest? Clients said they never got a follow-up.

Pricing wasn't the issue. The gap between sending a quote and closing it was — chased over WhatsApp, buried in inboxes, dropped entirely.

They moved their pipeline into SmartPRO Hub. Built the quote inside the CRM, sent it with one click. The client signed via e-signature that same afternoon.

No back-and-forth. No printed PDF. No "let me check with my team."

That one deal became a repeatable process. Every quote now has a status. Every follow-up is logged. Accepted deals move automatically to invoicing.

The number that actually mattered: average quote-to-acceptance time dropped from 6 days to same-day on deals where the client had portal access.

One system — CRM, client portal, e-signature, invoicing — instead of four apps and a WhatsApp thread.

SmartPRO Hub starts at OMR 12/month. 14-day free trial, no credit card.
